notes: Single-attestation, textually contested form: Strong's own headline meaning is "to annihilate" (this occurrence shares consonants with the number-word "six" too, and some render it "leave but the sixth part of thee"). "Drive" follows a third reading (paired with "turn thee back" in the same clause), reflected in some modern translations ("I will turn you around and drive you"). Shipped per the person's gloss; flagging the three-way dispute rather than presenting it as settled.
